name: e6_sanity_checks
description: Negative controls and invariances. Placebo: copula oracles with IC 0 under ten seeds, whose Sharpe must centre on zero with bootstrap intervals that cover it. Seed dispersion: random-noise oracles at IC 0.03 under ten seeds, the spread a single-seed result hides. Invariance: at IC 1 the tails, middle and random oracles are the same forecast and must give identical rows.
